requested_outcome: A comprehensive automatic QA system that detects functional regressions across VII, explicitly including maps, at risk-based frequencies without testing accessibility or typography.
natural_destination: The public VII site and the authenticated /admin/quality command center.
authorization_boundary: Read-only production probes, repository changes, tests and the previously authorized VII publication are allowed. No bookings, leads, reviews, payments, messages or destructive actions may be created.

lesson_bundle.reason: The requested scope is the whole existing product family.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Inventory every page and shared component family instead of sampling only eight URLs.

lesson_bundle.reason: Maps, sliders, galleries, filters and dialogs fail in nested interaction states.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Add a scheduled browser interaction matrix for desktop, mobile and low-height states.

lesson_bundle.reason: Responsive state transitions have repeatedly caused public regressions.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Include breakpoint, reload and overlay cleanup in deep browser QA.

lesson_bundle.reason: Technical success alone previously missed obvious public mobile defects.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require public screenshots and meaningful visible content in deep QA reports.

lesson_bundle.reason: VII has project-specific map, search, availability, gallery and place-page contracts.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Use VII_PLATFORM_MASTER_PLAN.md and VII_FEEDBACK_STANDARD.md as semantic oracles.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The dashboard is green while a map is missing.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Probe the static map image endpoint and run browser checks that activate the live map.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A missing snapshot or failed map activation creates a named incident.

predicted_rejections.prevention: Publish a registry covering every public template, world and critical API family.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The admin registry exposes the complete family inventory and cadence.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A 200 response passes although the required component disappeared.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use semantic response assertions for required and forbidden content, content type and minimum size.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A fixture returning generic HTML fails a component-specific check.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The automatic schedule exists only in code and never runs.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Verify a new public scheduled run after deployment and retain an idempotent visitor heartbeat fallback.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The production dashboard records a scheduled run with the expanded registry.

predicted_rejections.prevention: Keep recurring probes GET-only and make deep browser tests inspect contact targets without sending.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The test matrix contains no mutation, call, message, lead, review, booking or payment action.

midpoint_gate.trigger: After semantic registry and map probes pass locally but before public deployment.

attack_questions: Can a generic 200 HTML page still pass a map or component check?
Can the same scheduled window run twice?
Can a missing map snapshot remain invisible?
Can an accessibility or typography audit slip into the registry?
Can production monitoring create an external side effect?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: A public /admin/quality run containing expanded checks and explicit map results.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Automated matrix plus public desktop/mobile evidence for every scheduled tier.

effectiveness.baseline: Version 606 has eight status/content-type probes and cannot detect missing maps or components.
effectiveness.target: Every critical family is represented, semantic failures open incidents, and the observed missing map is no longer silently green.
